description: Unit tests for the HttpRequestActor class within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing HTTP request handling for various scenarios including command processing, acknowledgment handling, and response generation.

classes.name: HttpRequestActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the HttpRequestActor, covering various request and response scenarios.

methods.name: handlesWhoamiCommand
methods.description: Tests handling of the /whoami GET request, verifying correct response.

methods.name: generateLocationHeaderInTwinPersistedAcknowledgementWithCreatedStatusCode
methods.description: Tests generation of Location header in acknowledgment response after a successful attribute modification.

methods.name: handlesThingModifyCommand
methods.description: Tests handling of a 'modify thing attribute' command, expecting a NO_CONTENT response.

methods.name: handlesThingModifyCommandLive
methods.description: Tests handling of a live channel modify command, expecting a NO_CONTENT response with specific headers.

methods.name: liveResponseHeadersDoNotCauseSpurious202Accepted
methods.description: Verifies that live response headers do not cause a 202 (Accepted) status unexpectedly.

methods.name: handlesThingModifyCommandLiveNoResponseRequired
methods.description: Tests that a modify command with responseRequired=false returns a 202 (Accepted).

methods.name: handlesThingModifyCommandLiveNoResponseRequiredAndLiveResponseAckRequest
methods.description: Verifies behavior when response is not required but acknowledgment request is present, expecting 202 (Accepted).

methods.name: handlesMessageCommand
methods.description: Tests handling of message commands and the subsequent response, including content type handling.

methods.name: forwardMessageCommandResponseWithInconsistentContentTypes
methods.description: Checks response when message and payload content types are inconsistent.

methods.name: handlesMessageCommandNoResponseRequired
methods.description: Verifies handling of message commands where no response is expected, expecting a 202 (Accepted).

methods.name: handlesMessageCommandNoResponseRequiredAndLiveResponseAckRequest
methods.description: Tests edge case where no response is required but acknowledgment is requested, expecting 202 (Accepted).
